title: Evaluation of the completed decision tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a nonempty alphabet, let $f$ map inputs on $n$ coordinates over $\Omega$ to $\alpha$, and let $u$ and $x$ be two such inputs. Given a set $A$ of available coordinates, suppose $u_i=x_i$ for every coordinate $i$ outside $A$. Then the tree constructed from $f$, the partial input $u$, and the available set $A$ evaluates on $x$ to $f(x)$.
